brief: 从零探索沧海 Sōkai、深海 Shinkai，各三个不同风格的方向。

prompts.sokai:
Use case: logo-brand. A completely fresh, imagination-led visual identity for "沧海 Sōkai". No existing reference image or previous brand is relevant. You are an outstanding experimental graphic designer presenting ONE beautifully resolved creative direction, not a corporate template.

Emotional world: a boundless sea, salt wind, sunlit freedom, wild elegance, a little unexpected joy. Design an original abstract symbol that feels like a piece of the ocean caught by the wind. Think a single impossible, beautifully balanced, windswept shape with a surprising cut of empty space. Bold, off-center, sculptural yet perfectly FLAT, with confident proportions. Let the form feel alive. Invent the shape freely; avoid generic stock waves and circular swooshes. It should have the immediate presence of a great contemporary cultural institution's mark. A recognizable silhouette is essential.

Art direction: rich saturated ultramarine on warm ivory, with a tiny unexpected vermilion-orange accent as a second independent element if composition benefits. Two solid spot colors, no gradients, no glass, no bevels, no 3D, no drop shadows. Beautiful slightly tactile paper is welcome, while the actual logo stays crisp and reproductible. Think collectible independent magazine meets Japanese contemporary art, not financial services.

Composition: a striking square brand presentation. Huge, beautifully composed primary mark in the upper half, generous clear space, expressive custom lettering below: exact Chinese "沧海", and exact Latin "Sōkai" subtly below or beside. Treat typography as a designed part of the identity: warm, confident, unusual but highly legible, not an ordinary luxury high-contrast serif. Make sure the ō has a macron. At the very bottom a discreet small monochrome repetition of the SAME symbol shows that it works as an actual logo, no containers or UI cards. No other words, no captions, no grid, no palette swatches, no mockups. The picture itself must be beautiful enough to pin on a studio wall. Design a finished coherent concept, not an exploration sheet full of alternatives.
prompts.shinkai:
Use case: logo-brand. Design a completely original, aesthetically ambitious visual identity for "深海 Shinkai", from a blank page. No prior brand image is relevant. You are an outstanding experimental graphic designer. Create ONE compelling finished concept with mystery, imagination, and exquisite restraint.

Creative idea: "an unknown life-form suspended in the abyss". Invent a mesmerizing abstract glyph: a single asymmetric folded fin or membrane, full-bodied through its center and tapering into a few exquisitely drawn blades, with an eccentric negative-space cut. It should feel alive, unfamiliar, quietly intelligent, like the emblem of an undiscovered underwater civilization. Find an unexpected, memorable silhouette. This is a graphically SIMPLE SYMBOL, not an illustration of a real animal. It must remain striking when printed entirely in one color. Avoid obvious water drops, waves, whirlpools, circles, eyes, submarines, octopuses and generic technology marks.

Art direction: an almost-black aubergine background; luminous pale acid yellow-green for the symbol; warm bone-white typography. All solid colors. The luminosity comes from the color contrast, NOT a rendered glow, gradient, metallic sheen, 3D, glass or a shadow. The tone is poetic, uncanny, extremely elegant, closer to an avant-garde art label than corporate branding. Confident negative space and meticulous optical balance.

Composition: an arresting square identity poster with generous negative space. ONE large glyph floats in the upper-middle area, with beautiful custom typography "深海" beneath, and exact "Shinkai" more discreetly below. Chinese characters must be correct and clearly legible; typography is sparse, slender, carefully spaced and subtly strange, with precision rather than decorative calligraphy. The icon is the emotional center. At the bottom, a tiny discreet bone-white repetition of the SAME glyph demonstrates the one-color logo, no cards, no grid, no captions. No other text, no palette labels, no scene, no packaging mockups, no wallpaper of little symbols. Every element should feel art-directed, confident and unforgettable.
